topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? Your partner's been weaving your story into a novel—like, how romantic is that? It’s like the world’s most personal gift. I mean, think about it, all those quiet moments, the things you’ve shared, the memories you’ve made... to find out they’re so precious to them that they’re writing them down, making them part of something bigger. It’s a whole new way of being seen, isn’t it? I’m just so happy for you. It’s like your bond is turning into a story that’s not just for the two of you anymore. It’s amazing, and I can’t wait to read it!
